Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs, names, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4004822. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id matching the document ID, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
